scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); function copyDir(src, dest) { if(!fs.existsSync(dest)) fs.mkdirSync(dest, {recursive:true}); const entries=fs.readdirSync(src, {withFileTypes:true}); for(let e of entries){ const sPath=src+'/'+e.name; const dPath=dest+'/'+e.name; if(e.isDirectory()){ if(e.name!=='node_modules'&&e.name!=='.git'&&e.name!=='public') copyDir(sPath, dPath); } else { try{ fs.copyFileSync(sPath, dPath); }catch(_){} } } } copyDir('.', 'public'); console.log('Build complete - all public assets synced.');"
